notes.title: Jumpkin Update Version 5.0
notes.notes:
Hello Jumpkin players! With the new update, we’ve added a brand-new game mode: JumpRace!

[h1]New Game Mode: JumpRace[/h1]
[list]
[*] Try to be the first player to finish the race by overcoming obstacles!
[*] Speed, reflexes, and perfect timing are crucial!
[*] Chaotic and fun races await you!
[/list]

[h1]9 New Race Maps[/h1]
[list]
[*] 9 unique JumpRace maps have been added to the game.
[*] Each map has different difficulty levels and obstacles.
[*] Can you be the fastest on all maps and leave your rivals behind?
[/list]

[h1]New Obstacles[/h1]
[list]
[*] New obstacles have been added to make the races even more exciting!
[*] Find the fastest route without getting stuck on obstacles and win the race!
[/list]

We can’t wait to see your performance in the JumpRace mode! Don’t forget to share your feedback on the update. Have fun!

notes.title: Jumpkin Update Version 4.0
notes.notes:
[h1]New Game Mode: Exploding Pumpkins 💥[/h1]
[list]
[*]If you have the bomb, touch someone before your time runs out and escape! Otherwise, it will explode, and you’ll be eliminated!
[/list]

[h1]🌟New Features Added[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]New Lobby List Design:[/b] The game lobby now looks sleeker and more user-friendly!
[*][b]Double Jump and Speed Boost Effects:[/b] Now they look even cooler!
[*][b]Game Mode Descriptions:[/b] You can now see how to play each mode inside the game.
[/list]

[h1]🛠️ Fixes & Improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*][b]Crown Hunt:[/b] Fixed the issue where players who left the game didn’t lose their crown.
[*][b]Death Effect:[/b] Improved visuals and animations.
[*][b]Trampoline Animation:[/b] Fixed inconsistencies.
[*][b]Enemy Elimination Mechanics:[/b] Improved to be more responsive and balanced.
[/list]

More action, fun, and chaos await you with this update!

[b]Join the game and jump into the fight![/b]

notes.title: Jumpkin Update Version 3.0
notes.notes:
Hello Jumpkin Community, here is a new adrenaline-filled game mode! It's time to chase, defeat and score big. Everything you need to know:

[h1]New game mode: Crown Hunt
[/h1]

[list]
[*] Objective: Hold on to the crown for as long as possible to earn points!
[*] The longer you hold on to the crown, the more points you earn.
[*] Be careful, everyone is after you! Run, jump and dodge to stay on top.
[/list]
[h1]Other improvements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Improved performance for a smoother experience.
[*] Minor bug fixes to improve overall gameplay.
[/list]
This update brings intense action and fierce competition to Jumpkin. Are you ready to prove yourself the ultimate Crown Hunt Champion?

Join now and start watching!
